name: agentchat-cloud
description: Mobile-first Cloudflare Browser Run, eight-web-AI orchestration, and ChatGPT App endpoint for AgentChat

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/mcp.js && node --check src/providers.js && node --check src/runner.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/pwa.js && node --check public/sw.js && npm test && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler-dry-run

AGENTCHAT_API_TOKEN.description: Required secret. Use a private random string of at least 32 characters. You will enter this same AgentChat access token once on your iPhone; it is not an AI password.

AUTH_STATE_KEY.description: Required secret. Use a different private random string of at least 32 characters. It encrypts saved browser login state.

MCP_API_TOKEN.description: Optional secret for the MCP endpoint. Leave unset if you do not use MCP.
